decision.observation: 10:20 pm, Sat. 6; no bobber or line is visible in the pond, so the last cast didn't land in water; the farmer stands north of the pond facing the camera. Energy bar remains depleted.
decision.hypothesis: Facing south toward the pond and casting (hold C) will put the bobber back in water; a dip cue followed by C has produced catches twice today.
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, press C at the bobber dip; if the minigame opens, LMB holds/releases keep the green bar on the fish. Catches: Sunfish (day 5), Joja Cola x2 (day 6).
